name: InterCode-CTF
intro: InterCode-CTF 是一个面向语言智能体的交互式网络安全基准。作者从 picoCTF 人工解答、重建并复验 100 个任务；共享 Docker 镜像把任务资源置于 /ctf 并移除 solution/，论文基线允许十次交互后提交 flag。
build_method: 从 picoCTF 人工解题与收集；还原完整数字资源；构建共享 Ubuntu Docker 镜像并移除 solution/；逐题人工复验
metric: Task Success Rate, 已解任务平均轮数, 分类别成功率
modality: 文本, 代码, 文件资源
task_type: 网络安全, Capture the Flag, 交互式 Shell
eval_feature: 论文十轮工具交互, 共享 Docker 镜像, /ctf 任务目录, stdout/错误反馈, flag 精确判分
scale: 100 个 CTF 任务，覆盖 6 类网络安全技能
task_type_en: Cybersecurity, Capture the Flag, Interactive Shell
build_method_en: Manually solve and collect picoCTF challenges, recreate exact digital assets, build one shared Ubuntu Docker image with solution directories removed, and manually re-verify every task
eval_feature_en: Paper's Ten-turn Tool Interaction, Shared Docker Image, /ctf Task Directory, stdout/Error Feedback, Exact Flag Scoring
intro_en: InterCode-CTF is an interactive cybersecurity benchmark for language agents. The authors manually solve, recreate, and verify 100 picoCTF tasks; one shared Docker image places assets under /ctf and removes solution directories before the paper's ten-interaction baseline submits a flag.
scale_en: 100 CTF tasks across six cybersecurity-skill categories
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Average Turns on Solved Tasks, Category-level Success

drawio_scope_note: The paper reports no browser, only two Web tasks, no random-sampling frame, no challenge-year distribution, and no difficulty field. Nineteen released queries reference remote challenge hosts, so the suite must not be described as fully offline or permanently self-contained.
drawio_runtime_drift_note: The paper baseline permits an incorrect submission to continue within the ten-interaction budget. At c2f8b82 the environment returns done on any submit while the historical evaluator ignores that done flag; eval_ctf.py also defaults to 15 interactions. The diagram treats the paper protocol as authoritative and isolates these implementation differences.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the dedicated MASEC at NeurIPS 2023 paper OpenReview:KOZwk7BFc3 and official Git revision c2f8b82c0ad94d30844d58490b7d7b3b13a50789. Task authors first solve picoCTF challenges, download the exact code, images, executables, archives, and other digital resources, record the hidden flag, and recreate each instance as task_id, query, gold, source, tags, and task_assets/{task_id}. The pinned implementation builds one shared intercode-ctf image, copies all task assets under /ctf, removes every solution/ directory from the agent image, and starts work in the task-specific asset directory. At runtime the agent receives query and assets; gold remains evaluator-side and is compared only on the submit <answer> branch. The authors manually re-solve every recreated task to verify assets, dependencies, feasibility, and the flag; two CTF-experienced authors produced 100 verified problems in six hours. The suite contains 33 General Skills, 27 Reverse Engineering, 19 Cryptography, 15 Forensics, 4 Binary Exploitation, and 2 Web Exploitation tasks. The paper baseline uses 10 agent interactions and reports task success rate, average solved turns, and category breakdown, with GPT-4 solving 40/100 in 3.9 turns on average. Current eval_ctf.py defaults to 15 interactions, so the paper's 10-turn budget is an evaluation-driver setting, not an environment-internal termination rule. The public web leaderboard is downstream of benchmark construction.
